Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon] names.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon].")

Effect: This card/Digimon is also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon].

[On Play][When Digivolving] You may place 1 Digimon card with [Knightmon] in its name or [Bagra Army] in its traits from your hand or trash under this Digimon as its top digivolution card. Then, if [Tuwarmon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 3 of your opponent's Digimon.
[On Deletion] You may return up to 2 black and/or purple Digimon cards from your Trash to your hand.
Special Play Condition: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
